package.welcome_message: Welcome to your 3-day Jordan adventure - Amman, Petra, and Wadi Rum - curated with authentic local experiences.

trip.title: Amman · Petra · Wadi Rum
trip.summary: Three days of historic exploration, natural wonder, and photography opportunities. Each day is confined to one region: Amman, Petra, then Wadi Rum. Morning visits are outdoors, afternoons are reserved for shade, meals, or indoor sites.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Amman, Petra, then Wadi Rum. Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 3 places to visit and 2 meals each day.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting and confusing.
decisions.effect: Your days follow Amman, Petra, then Wadi Rum.

decisions.title: Your first night is near the airport
decisions.effect: Night one is a hotel in Amman, as close to the airport as the listings allow.

decisions.title: Sleep first — you still have a day
decisions.why: You land at 03:02, before the city is awake.
decisions.effect: Go to the hotel and rest properly. After breakfast, an easy nearby visit is possible because you arrived so early.

decisions.title: Then you move closer to the places you came for
decisions.why: Sleeping in the same city you visit beats a long commute every morning.
decisions.effect: After the arrival night, the hotel follows the rest of the route.

decisions.title: Your must-see places get proper time
decisions.effect: Those places are planned from real sites in that area, not borrowed from a nearby city.

decisions.title: Mornings for the outdoors
decisions.why: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
decisions.effect: Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon.

decisions.title: A balanced pace
decisions.effect: About 3 places to visit and 2 meals each day.

decisions.title: 4 star stays
decisions.effect: Hotels are taken from listings at that star level when the city has them. If it does not, we use the closest listed tier and say so.

decisions.title: A comfort budget
decisions.effect: We lean toward more comfortable stays and dining when those places exist.

decisions.title: Chosen around what you care about

days.summary: You land before dawn in Amman. Sleep first, then breakfast. After you rest, the remaining day stays in Amman: Amman Citadel, Amman Citadel Flagpole, The Jordan Museum.

schedule.name: InterContinental Jordan
schedule.description: Long-established five-star IHG hotel on Islamic College Street in Jabal Amman, between the Second and Third Circles, with six restaurants, indoor and outdoor pools, a spa and a 24-hour reception.
schedule.reason: You land before dawn. Go to your hotel and sleep properly — this is rest, not a visit. The day starts after you wake. 5-star stay, as requested

schedule.name: Hashem Restaurant
schedule.description: An iconic, legendary open-air street-level eatery in downtown Amman serving traditional Jordanian breakfast staples.
schedule.reason: Breakfast after rest — kitchens were closed when you landed.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Amman Citadel
schedule.description: Historic national site situated on a hill in central Amman featuring ancient ruins from the Bronze Age through the Islamic era.
schedule.reason: You still have time after resting, so the day continues nearby — not a long drive.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Cantaloupe Gastro Pub
schedule.description: A sophisticated rooftop gastro pub in Jabal Amman offering innovative cocktails, international fusion cuisine, and citadel views.
schedule.reason: Lunch nearby. You still have afternoon left in the same city.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Amman Citadel Flagpole
schedule.description: Massive national flagpole visible across Amman, located on the Royal Palace compound near the Citadel.
schedule.reason: You still have time after resting, so the day continues nearby — not a long drive.

schedule.name: The Jordan Museum
schedule.description: Jordan's premier national history museum displaying archaeological treasures including Dead Sea Scrolls.
schedule.reason: You still have time after resting, so the day continues nearby — not a long drive.
matched_preferences: Indoor option on a hot day
One visit covering the nearby monuments

days.transport_notes: You land at 03:02. The drive from Queen Alia to Amman is about 45 minutes. Times below start after that transfer.

days.summary: A full day of Petra's iconic sites, scenic trails, and a local Bedouin lunch, capped with a fine-dining dinner.

schedule.name: Al-Khazneh (The Treasury)
schedule.description: Iconic Nabataean rock-cut temple facade carved into the rose-red sandstone cliff face at Petra.
schedule.reason: Must-see Petra highlight, early morning to avoid heat.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Al-Maddras Trail & High Viewpoint
schedule.description: Alternative entry trail into Petra featuring sacred rock carvings and elevated perspectives.
schedule.reason: Scenic hike that complements the Treasury visit.

schedule.name: Bedouin Cave Cafe
schedule.description: Rustic teahouse inside Petra archaeological park near the Treasury view points.
schedule.reason: Light lunch in a historic setting, keeping the afternoon cool.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Al-Mu'aysrah Temple Trail
schedule.description: Ancient residential and temple complex trail in north-western Petra.
schedule.reason: Explores less-visited Nabataean sites, adding depth to the day.

schedule.name: Crown Plaza Basin Restaurant
schedule.description: Historic restaurant inside Petra archaeological park near the start of the Monastery trail.
schedule.reason: Fine-dining dinner to celebrate the day's exploration.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Petra Marriott Hotel
schedule.description: Five-star Marriott hotel on a ridge along Queen Rania Al Abdallah Street, offering spa and seasonal outdoor pool.
schedule.reason: Overnight stay in Petra. This is your hotel, not an activity. 5-star stay, as requested

days.transport_notes: This evening you check in to your hotel in Petra.

days.summary: A desert adventure featuring the visitor center, a historic spring, and a canyon trek, finished with a Bedouin dinner.

schedule.name: Wadi Rum Visitor Center
schedule.description: Main operational gateway and orientation center for the UNESCO-listed Wadi Rum Protected Area.
schedule.reason: Quick orientation and photo opportunity at the start of the day.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Lawrence's Spring
schedule.description: Natural mountain spring associated with T.E. Lawrence's desert travels.
schedule.reason: Cool, shaded spot for a quick break and photos.

schedule.name: Wadi Rum Visitor Center Rest House
schedule.description: Historical rest house and eatery at Rum Village entrance, serving travelers and desert trekkers.
schedule.reason: Light lunch near the visitor center, keeping the afternoon cool.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Barrah Canyon
schedule.description: 5-kilometer long majestic sandstone canyon in eastern Wadi Rum, popular for trekking and rock climbing.
schedule.reason: Extended outdoor adventure that showcases the desert's dramatic landscape.

schedule.name: Captain's Desert Camp Restaurant Wadi Rum
schedule.description: Desert camp restaurant serving traditional Bedouin buffet dinners around central campfires.
schedule.reason: Authentic Bedouin dinner to conclude the desert experience.
